[preface]
== Preface

Default: <<chapter>>; <<plain>>; <<appendix>>.

Basic: xref:chapter[xrefstyle=basic]; xref:plain[xrefstyle=basic]; xref:appendix[xrefstyle=basic].

Short: xref:chapter[xrefstyle=short]; xref:plain[xrefstyle=short]; xref:appendix[xrefstyle=short].

Full: xref:chapter[xrefstyle=full]; xref:plain[xrefstyle=full]; xref:appendix[xrefstyle=full].

Fallback: xref:chapter[xrefstyle=unknown]; xref:chapter[xrefstyle=""].

Explicit: xref:chapter[Custom *label*,xrefstyle=basic]; xref:labelled[xrefstyle=basic].

:xrefstyle: basic

Document basic: <<chapter>>; <<plain>>; <<appendix>>; <<section>>; <<labelled>>.

Document note.footnote:[<<chapter>>.]

Script: ^xref:chapter[xrefstyle=basic]^.
